protocol: interp-exposure-v1 (PI spec 2026-11-23; clean-to-pure-noise interpolation; new-batch-exposure layer coverage, rank rule 1e-9)

manifest.protocol: interp-exposure-v1: x_i(alpha) = (1-alpha) * y_i + alpha * z_i in RAW [0,1] pixel coordinates, THEN the saved MNIST centering + PCA-256 + scaling (apply_preprocessing with the run's own preprocessing.pt); same original X every condition, Y_alpha only; REPLACES the additive-noise sweep in the planned paper figure (results/newinput/ preserved untouched; SVHN remains a separate comparison)
manifest.noise: z_i ~ U[0,1]^784 per test image, torch.rand, fp64, single fixed Generator seed 20261123; REUSED across all interpolation steps AND all model seeds
manifest.clean_reference: results/atomic/mnist_mlp_seed<sd>_new_batch.json late_endpoint/batches/test (authenticated; alpha=0 must reproduce it exactly, dims per block)
manifest.rank_rule: relative 1e-09; union rank resolved iff gap >= 10; unresolved cells keep their ladder ranges (1e-6/1e-9/1e-12) and band counts, thresholds NEVER changed

decisions.partial_runs: any --alphas invocation writes mnist_mlp_seed<sd>_interp_partial_<tag>.json, never the full-record filename (one job per output file); the full run recomputes every condition into its own file
decisions.alpha0_recomputed: alpha=0 recomputed, not copied; its raw input is bitwise identical to the clean test batch of the new-batch records ((1-0)*y01 + 0*z == y01; (raw01*255)/255 round-trip bitwise exact, verified 2026-11-23)
decisions.gate_qualification: unresolved gaps are QUALIFIED flags with ladder ranges, not hard gate failures: at alpha=0 the gap equals the accepted clean reference's own gap (PI acceptance memos/2026-11-16_newinput_gate_acceptance.md); the strict outcome is preserved in seed<sd>_gate.json (strict_pass)
